description_expanded: Overview5.0(2 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Luxury Beach Home!* Private Heated Pool and Hot Tub * Elevator – Convenient access throughout the home* Stunning Gulf Views* 4 Complimentary Bikes * Two Large Living Areas – Plenty of comfortable gathering space for your entire group* Multiple Exterior Decks – Relax outdoors and enjoy the beautiful Gulf views* Electric Vehicle Charging – Convenient on-site EV charging available* Pet Friendly (add'l $250 fee, 1 pet under 15lbs)* 3–4 Minute Walk to the Beach – Access via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover. Please Note: Beach access is via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover. The beach walkover includes stairs and is not handicap accessible. * Close to 30A Dining and Boutique Shopping – Convenient access to restaurants, shops, and local attractions* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **The neighborhood is growing, and construction may be taking place nearby, including in front of the home. Construction is outside of our control, and we want to be upfront so there are no surprises during your stay. We appreciate your understanding as this beautiful area continues to develop. **Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Coastal View, your ultimate luxury multi-family beach retreat in beautiful Inlet Beach! This custom-designed home features 8 spacious bedrooms, 9 ensuite bathrooms, 2 half bathrooms, two large living areas, and multiple exterior decks, providing plenty of room for everyone to relax, gather, and enjoy an unforgettable 30A vacation. Inside, offers a luxurious and comfortable setting with two large living areas, a gourmet kitchen with high-end finishes, Smart TVs, WiFi, and an elevator for added convenience. With plenty of space to gather together or find a quiet place to relax. Step outside and experience your own private oasis featuring a custom heated pool and spa. Spend your days lounging poolside, relaxing in the spa, or enjoying the coastal breezes from one of the home's many outdoor decks. Coastal View comfortably sleeps up to 27 guests with seven King bedrooms and an impressive third-floor bunk room featuring three King beds, one Queen bed, and four Twin beds. The generous bedroom and bathroom configuration provides comfort and privacy for everyone in your group. Come start making lasting memories at Coastal View. The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomBunk Room: 3 King Beds, 1 Queen Bed & 4 Twin BedsArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
